data.description: Exploring Dubai Academic City: A Hub of Residential and Lifestyle Excellence

data.answer:
Green Community West is a tranquil, gated sub-community of the larger Green Community development. Developed by Properties Investment, a joint venture between Union Properties PJSC and Dubai Investments PJSC, this neighborhood is a preferred residential destination for those seeking a peaceful, suburban lifestyle. It offers a mix of villas, townhouses, and apartments surrounded by expansive green landscapes and tree-shaded walkways.

Part of the broader Green Community, this sub-community is particularly popular among families due to its safe environment, community-focused design, and abundance of leisure spaces. The neighborhood is also integrated into Dubai Investment Park, a multi-purpose development with both residential and commercial zones.

Green Community West real estate includes a diverse range of properties such as low-rise apartments, spacious townhouses, and large luxury villas. Apartments are typically found in 4-storey buildings and range from 1 to 2-bedroom configurations, offering sizes between 935 and 1,548 sq. ft. These units come equipped with built-in wardrobes, double-glazed windows, balconies, and marble flooring. Some apartments even feature separate accommodations for domestic help.

Townhouses and villas in Green Community West are available in 3 to 6-bedroom layouts. Villas boast large gardens, maid’s rooms, study areas, and extensive storage. Designed for spacious living, these homes are ideal for families looking for comfort and privacy.

Off-Plan Projects in Green Community West

As of now, Green Community West is largely a completed development. However, new residential phases and villa upgrades may be introduced as part of ongoing enhancements by Properties Investment LLC. Future projects within Dubai Investment Park may also influence property value and living standards in the area.

Renting a Property in Green Community West

Rental properties in Green Community West offer competitive rates considering the quality and spaciousness of the homes. The average annual rent for a 1-bedroom apartment is AED 83,000, while 2-bedroom units average AED 145,000. Townhouses and villas are priced higher but come with extensive living space and private gardens.

Buying a Property in Green Community West

Green Community West real estate offers excellent investment opportunities. The average sale price for a 1-bedroom apartment is AED 1,000,000, and AED 1,743,000 for a 2-bedroom unit. Villas and townhouses command higher prices but offer excellent value due to the generous plot sizes and high-quality finishes.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Green Community West, Dubai?

data.answer:
Living in Green Community West Dubai means enjoying a peaceful suburban lifestyle with all modern conveniences nearby. The area is quiet, family-oriented, and filled with greenery.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Green Community West

Each villa comes with a private garage, usually accommodating two vehicles. Apartments offer designated underground parking for residents. Public transport options are limited, so owning a car is recommended. However, Dubai Investment Park Metro Station is a short 7-minute drive away. Bus stops such as Union Residence 1 & 2 are serviced by F47, F48, and F51 buses.

Supermarkets in and Around Green Community West

Residents have easy access to several supermarkets including a local Choithrams branch within the community. Other nearby options include Afsha Mini Mart, Al Maya Supermarket, and Parco Supermarket, all within a 10-minute drive.

Shopping Mall in and Near Green Community West

For everyday shopping, The Market mall within the community is the go-to option. For a more comprehensive retail experience, residents can drive 20 minutes to reach Ibn Battuta Mall and Dubai Marina Mall, both offering top global brands, cinemas, and eateries.

Schools and Nurseries Near Green Community West

Educational options nearby include Chubby Cheeks Nursery, The Children’s Garden Green Community, and Dovecote Green Primary School, which offers the British curriculum. British Columbia Canadian School is also located nearby and follows the Canadian curriculum. Other schools like Greenfield Community School and Al Nibras International Private School are within easy reach.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Green Community West

There are several mosques within a short drive such as Al-Taqwa Masjid and Zulaikha Abdullah Abdul Karim Al Homidi Mosque. Christian residents can visit churches like St. Francis of Assisi and Christ Church Jebel Ali, about 15 minutes away. Guru Nanak Darbar Sikh Gurudwara is also nearby, while Hindu temples in Bur Dubai are around a 40-minute drive.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Green Community West

Residents benefit from access to quality healthcare facilities including GMCClinics, CareOne Polyclinic, and Mediclinic Me’aisem. NMC Royal Hospital is the closest full-service hospital and is just a short drive away.

Location & Nearby Areas

Green Community West is bordered by Green Community East and Green Community Village. Dubai Investment Park 1 is adjacent, providing a mix of commercial and residential developments. South Bay, a new development, is also just a few minutes away.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Green Community West, Dubai

data.answer:
The community offers several parks such as Green Community East Swing Park and DIP Public Park, all great for family outings. For a luxurious retreat, Courtyard by Marriott is nearby with its gym, martial arts facilities, and swimming pool.

Restaurants

A variety of dining options cater to diverse palates. Local favorites include Appam Corner Restaurant, VEG HUT, Vinkers Waffles, and SOBO. The Green Fridge offers healthy dining, while upscale options like Cucina Italian Kitchen and Al Arrab Restaurant are also within easy reach.

Beaches Near Green Community West

Although not located on the coast, residents can access Marina Beach in about 22 minutes. Jumeirah Public Beach and Salt Beach are also reachable within a 30-minute drive, making weekend beach trips feasible.

Hotels Around Green Community West

Courtyard by Marriott Dubai is the main hotel in the vicinity, offering high-quality hospitality and leisure facilities. It’s ideal for hosting guests or enjoying a weekend staycation.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Residents can maintain an active lifestyle with parks, jogging trails, and fitness centers like Atlas Power Gym, Fitness First Green Community, and Fly High Fitness, all located within a 10-minute drive.

Community Events

Events like the Christmas Black Tie Ball are held in Dubai Investment Park, featuring entertainment, food stalls, and charitable fundraising activities that bring the community together.

Attractions and Landmarks

Nearby attractions include The Els Club and Trump International Golf Course, both located around 20 minutes away. These are perfect spots for golf enthusiasts and leisure seekers alike.

Green Community West offers a peaceful, family-friendly environment with premium amenities. However, public transportation is limited, so having a personal vehicle is essential. Property prices are on the higher side due to the upscale nature of the community.

more_info.question: FAQs About Green Community West, Dubai

data.answer:
Is Green Community West good for families?

Yes, it’s one of the most family-oriented communities in Dubai with ample parks, schools, and safety features.

Are there public transport options in Green Community West?

It’s limited. Residents rely mainly on private vehicles, though the DIP Metro Station is nearby.

What types of properties are available?

The community offers apartments, townhouses, and villas.

data.content:
Located on the western end of the master-planned Green Community, Green Community West is a serene residential enclave that is part of Dubai Investment Park (DIP). Known for its lush green surroundings and family-friendly environment, Green Community West, Dubai Investment Park is considered one of the most desirable places to live in the city. The sub-community is designed with wide open spaces, landscaped gardens, and tree-lined streets, offering a peaceful retreat from the urban bustle.

Green Community West properties consist of well-planned villas, townhouses, and low-rise apartment buildings. The area is strategically positioned between Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) and Jebel Ali-Al Habibi Road (D57), providing excellent connectivity to both central Dubai and Abu Dhabi. This Green Community West area guide will take you through everything you need to know about living in this upscale, green oasis.

With ample Green Community amenities like schools, parks, supermarkets, and fitness centers, residents enjoy a high standard of living. The secure gated environment, combined with the beautiful landscape and thoughtful infrastructure, makes Green Community West real estate a top choice for families and professionals alike.
